name: Late Blight Fruit
symptoms: Dark brown or black lesions on fruits Firm rot with greasy appearance White mold growth under humid conditions Rapid fruit decay
description: Late blight fruit rot is a destructive disease caused by the oomycete Phytophthora infestans. It mainly affects tomato and potato plants. The pathogen infects fruits, leaves and stems and can spread rapidly under cool and humid conditions, often leading to severe crop losses.
management: cultural: Remove infected plants Improve air circulation Avoid overhead irrigation Use resistant cultivars when available chemical: Metalaxyl-based fungicides Chlorothalonil Mancozeb
